explanation: Store each value together with the maximum at that stack depth. Popping removes both, exposing the previous maximum. A Python list supplies the backing stack.
timeComplexity: Push/Pop: O(1) amortized with O(n) worst-case resize; Max/Empty: O(1)
spaceComplexity: O(n) current entries plus proportional Python list capacity
